items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: prisma
items.summary: Prisma 是专为 Node.js 和 TypeScript 打造的下一代 ORM，旨在让数据库访问变得简单、安全且高效。它通过 Prisma Schema 文件定义数据模型，自动生成类型安全的客户端，无需手写 SQL 或处理繁琐的映射。核心亮点在于声明式建模与自动迁移，让开发者专注业务逻辑而非数据库细节。典型应用于后端服务、API 开发和微服务架构，尤其适合需要强类型检查的项目。你可以尝试通过定义 schema，运行 prisma migrate 生成数据库表，随后在代码中利用完整类型提示进行增删改查，极大提升开发体验与代码可靠性。
items.summary_en: Prisma is a next-generation ORM that simplifies database access for Node.js and TypeScript applications. It provides a type-safe query builder and auto-generated client, eliminating manual SQL and reducing boilerplate. Its core strength is the declarative data model definition via Prisma Schema, which syncs with the database schema and generates a fully typed client. Developers use it for rapid backend development, especially in microservices and APIs. You can experiment by defining a schema, running migrations, and querying with full autocompletion and type safety.

items.name: ai-job-search
items.summary: ai-job-search 是基于 Claude Code 的开源求职自动化框架，利用AI自动处理简历投递中的重复劳动：评估职位匹配度、定制简历、撰写求职信、准备面试。技术上，它借助Claude的推理能力比对个人资料与职位描述，自动生成个性化求职材料。使用简单：Fork仓库并填写教育、技能、经历等信息，其余由Claude完成，包括抓取岗位要求、生成定制材料及模拟面试。该项目将大模型变为私人求职助手，显著提升申请效率，适合批量投递的求职者或希望自动化招聘流程的团队。
items.summary_en: ai-job-search is an open-source framework that automates job applications using Claude Code. It solves the tedious process of tailoring CVs, writing cover letters, and preparing for interviews. Technically, it leverages Claude's reasoning to evaluate job descriptions against your profile and generate personalized application materials. To use it, fork the repository, fill in your profile, and let Claude handle the rest—from job matching to interview prep. This project turns an LLM into your personal career assistant, saving hours per application.

items.name: OfficeCLI
items.summary: OfficeCLI是首个专为AI代理设计的办公套件命令行工具，解决LLM处理Office文档时无原生接口的问题。它编译为单个二进制文件，无需安装Office即可读写Word、Excel和PowerPoint，使AI代理能像人类一样操作文档。技术亮点在于提供纯净脚本化界面，支持文档生成、数据提取、格式调整等全流程自动化。开发者可将其集成到代理管道，如自动处理发票、从数据库生成简报或批量修改合同模板。核心优势是低依赖、高兼容，一个命令完成复杂办公任务。
items.summary_en: OfficeCLI is a free, open-source CLI tool purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Unlike traditional Office suites, it compiles into a single binary with no Office installation required, making it ideal for agent workflows. Its core strength lies in providing a clean, scriptable interface that mimics human office operations, enabling agents to handle document generation, data extraction, and report formatting without GUI overhead. Developers can integrate it into agent pipelines for tasks like automated invoice processing or slide deck generation from structured data.

items.name: CubeSandbox
items.summary: CubeSandbox是腾讯云开源的轻量级沙箱，专为AI智能体设计，提供即时启动、并发执行与安全隔离能力。它利用Rust语言的内存安全与高效并发特性，构建毫秒级启动的隔离容器，避免传统虚拟机的开销，从而支持安全的多智能体协作。开发者可将其用于运行智能体的不可信代码、测试多智能体工作流，或集成到LangChain等框架中，以在不牺牲性能的前提下增强安全性与可靠性。
items.summary_en: CubeSandbox is a lightweight sandbox designed for AI agents, enabling instant, concurrent, and secure code execution. Its key innovation lies in leveraging Rust's memory safety and efficient concurrency model to create low-overhead containers that start in milliseconds, facilitating safe multi-agent coordination. Developers can use CubeSandbox to run untrusted agent code, test multi-agent workflows, or integrate it into agent frameworks like LangChain to enhance security and performance without compromising speed.

items.name: DesktopCommanderMCP
items.summary: DesktopCommanderMCP 是一个基于 MCP 协议的服务端，让 Claude 获得终端控制、文件系统搜索和差异编辑能力。其核心在于通过标准化接口将 AI 与操作系统连接，使得 Claude 不仅能理解指令，还能直接执行命令、定位文件并应用精确的代码修改。开发者可将其集成到开发流程中，实现自动化测试、代码重构或项目文件管理，让 AI 真正动手操作，而不仅停留在对话层面。
items.summary_en: DesktopCommanderMCP is an MCP server that equips Claude with direct terminal control, file system search, and diff-based file editing. By integrating these capabilities via the Model Context Protocol, it turns Claude into an autonomous coding assistant that can execute commands, manipulate files, and apply precise edits. Developers can use it to automate development workflows, run tests, or manage projects interactively, bridging the gap between AI reasoning and system-level actions.

items.name: autoremesher
items.summary: Autoremesher是一款自动四边形网格重构工具，能将杂乱三角网格高效转化为规整四边形网格，解决手动重拓扑的痛点。其核心算法基于方向场引导或奇点优化，自动生成排列整齐、变形误差小的网格。作为轻量级C++命令行工具，采用MIT开源协议，可无缝嵌入游戏美术或动画流程，快速生成干净四边形拓扑。显著提升建模效率，尤其适用于需要高精度四边形的细分曲面或UV展开场景。
items.summary_en: Autoremesher is an automatic quad remeshing tool that converts triangle meshes into clean quad-dominant meshes, a common but tedious task in 3D modeling. It employs a robust algorithm—likely based on field-guided or singularity-aware techniques—to produce high-quality quad layouts without manual intervention. Being a lightweight C++ command-line tool with an MIT license, it can be easily integrated into game development or animation pipelines to accelerate retopology workflows. Experiment with it to simplify character or hard-surface quad remeshing.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
